name: upgrade-refusals
description: The other refusals of a request for /ws: a method other than GET is 405 (not the hook path's 404), missing upgrade headers 400, a version other than 13 is 426, a missing key 400. Each is answered and closed.
reason: A request for /ws is the protocol's whatever its method; only a valid upgrade switches protocols (HK-218, HK-220 to HK-222).
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.7; docs/protocol.md spec v0. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/listener.rs listener_scenarios plays every step through protocol::listener::Listener. Swift: ProtocolServerTests drives the same rules over a real loopback socket.

steps.reason: Settings start the listener: the start stops first (generation 1), then binds 127.0.0.1 with generation 2 (RemoteListener.swift:79-135).
The bind is ready: running, no problem (RemoteListener.swift:158-161).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 1 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

bytes.text:
POST /ws HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:48738
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13

effects.http:
HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed
Connection: close
Content-Length: 0

steps.reason: A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 2 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
